content: Jisas ginyenme yipihinge pupwa me miyeꞌ ende
Jisas top lenge jetalah kin yate jere yal pinip umun Galili nal umbur ŋaiye kekep lenge Gerasa.
Pe Jisas tahar nase loumbil pinip nat pe, kin ŋetekeꞌe miyeꞌ ende ŋaiye nye nyermbe kin narp ŋeser map pe, kin nata etekeꞌe Jisas. Miyeꞌ uku yipihinge pupwa si gahanahme kin.

Somohon tinge yupwaiꞌe ŋihip syep kin ni wula wula, kom kin pupwa bongol sekete pe, kin girngir merkinip topoꞌe ŋasarꞌe ain ŋaiye tinge si yupwaiꞌe ŋihip syep kin. Yukur tatame ŋaiye miyeꞌ ende ka orpe kin no, ka enge merkinip upwaiꞌe kin, pakai. Taꞌe luku pe, miyeꞌ uku tase narp ŋeheh nal ŋeser map ŋilyehme.
Ŋupe ŋau kin narp ŋeser map, topoꞌe kin narp nanah hwate pe, kin nas nas, topoꞌe kin nenge ŋeser ŋotombo wahriꞌ kin.
Miyeꞌ uku ŋetekeꞌe Jisas ŋaiye nat wohe pe, ki gertenge nate tambe gah ŋihip Jisas.

Jisas ŋaname kin na, “Yipihinge pupwa tus upwaihme miyeꞌ iki!” Kom miyeꞌ uku tambah nal hlaꞌ ŋaname Jisas na, “Jisas, Talah tikin Got Nanah Hlaꞌ, nin nasande na ende ŋam tuꞌe lai? Ŋam manange nato naŋ tikin Got, yukur na pule nihe syohe.”
Pe Jisas ŋisilihme kin na, “Naŋ nin lahmende?” Pe miyeꞌ uku nungwisme na, “Naŋ ŋam Ami. Ki taꞌe leꞌe, poi yipihinge wula wula sekete.”
Pe kin ŋisilihme Jisas bongol ŋaiye yukur ka ginyenme lenge yipihinge pupwa no, ka yi tus yusme moi uku, na pakai.
O hroꞌ wula wula sekete taꞌe ŋaiye 2,000 yono ŋai jan ya yanah hwate sehei me luh uku.
Pe lenge yipihinge pupwa luku yisilihme Jisas na, “Ember poi ya mi moto lenge hroꞌ uku.”

Taꞌe luku pe, Jisas ginyenme lenge yipihinge pupwa tas yasme miyeꞌ uku pe, tinge ya yoto lenge hroꞌ uku dindiꞌ me. Pe lenge hroꞌ lalme luku jertetenge susungurh ya jah hwate ya jah pinip umun pe, tinge yonoꞌe pinip pe, tinge yule.

Lenge miyeꞌ ŋaiye yembepeteme lenge hroꞌ uku jarnge yal moiye moiye pe, tinge yana lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge jande ŋaiꞌe ŋaiꞌe ŋaiye tinge si yetekeꞌe. Taꞌe luku pe, lenge mitiŋ yate yetekeꞌe ŋai uku jah hiꞌ.
Tinge yatme Jisas pe, tinge yetekeꞌe miyeꞌ ŋaiye sekeime yipihinge pupwa yarp kin. Kom miyeꞌ uku kin dendeꞌ temhroŋ pe, ŋoihmbwaip kin si bwore. Taꞌe luku pe, tinge hiꞌjarnge ŋembere sekete.
Lahmende ŋaiye yetekeꞌe ŋai uku pe, tinge plihe ya yana lenge miyeꞌ tuweinge syeꞌ me ŋaimune ŋaiye si ŋende me miyeꞌ uku ŋaiye yipihinge pupwa si narp kin topoꞌe lenge hroꞌ.
Pe tinge yisilih yisilihme Jisas ŋaiye ka tuhur el upwaihme moi tinge.
Sehei ŋaiye Jisas nala el unuh loumbil pinip pe, miyeꞌ ŋaiye somohon yipihinge pupwa yarp kin nate ŋisilihme Jisas na, “Iyai ŋam, ŋam da mil topoꞌe nin.”
Kom Jisas ŋaname kin na, “Pakai! Na plihe el lenge wim ilyeh nin. Na el ini lenge ŋaimune ŋaiye Lahmborenge si ŋoihginirme nin no, kin ŋende me nin.”

Taꞌe luku pe, miyeꞌ uku nasme Jisas pe, kin nato Dekapolis distrik pe, kin ŋana lenge ŋaimune ŋaiye Jisas si ŋende me kin. Taꞌe luku pe, lenge mitiŋ lalme ŋaiye yisande wusyep uku pe, tinge gunguru plai.
Talah tuwei Jairus topoꞌe tuwei ŋaiye wende wahriꞌ epwa wundehei
Jisas plihe nerŋe nal pinip umun nal pe, kin nal narp pinip umun tikih pe, mitiŋ wula wula yate yarp yonyorꞌme kin.
Miyeꞌ ende ŋaiye ŋembepeteme yukoh jahilyeh lenge Juta pe, naŋ kin Jairus. Kin topoꞌe nat ŋaiye ka etekeꞌe Jisas pe, kin tambe na gah ŋanar ŋihip Jisas.
Pe kin ŋututusme Jisas ŋanange marnge na, “Talah tuwei malaih ŋam da wule. Iyai, ote ikil syep nin el unuh ti pe, ta plihe bwore.”
Taꞌe pe, Jisas tahar nal topoꞌe kin pe, mitiŋ wula wula tahar dirndir yal topoꞌe Jisas pe, tinge jan burmbur yonyorꞌme kin.
Pe tinge mwande yal pe, tuwei ende ŋaiye wahriꞌ epwa wundehei ti, ki sai tatame wahtaip 12 watme Jisas.
Ti wiche wuhyau ti lalme walme lenge dokta ŋaiye ka yungwisme ti no, ta tuhur bwore. Kom pakai supule. Wahriꞌ epwa ti luku ki ŋende ŋembere supule.
Somohon ti wasande wusyep me Jisas pe, ti tahar wat. Ti gwande Jisas wotop lenge mitiŋ yat pe, ti wusuwaꞌe temhroŋ kin.
Ti ŋoihweryembe na, “Ŋaiye ma mil musuwaꞌe temhroŋ syum kin pe, ŋam se ma bwore.”
Taꞌe luku pe, ti wal wusuwaꞌe temhroŋ kin pe, nilyehe sai wahriꞌ epwa ti miꞌe pe, ti warp bwore. Pe ti sisyeme na, pupwa ti miꞌe ko.
O Jisas gan nato bumbe mitiŋ wula wula sekete pe, kin ŋasande ŋaiye bongol si nasme kin pe, kin bunjenge ŋisilih na, “Lahmende ŋusuwaꞌe temhroŋ ŋam?”
Pe lenge jetalah kin plihe yungwisme wusyep kin na, “Etekeꞌe mitiŋ wula wula sekete jan yonyorꞌme nin eꞌe. Te isilih na, lahmende narpe temhroŋ nin tale?”
Kom Jisas te bep osoko nalꞌe nalꞌe de ka etekeꞌe lahmende ŋaiye ŋende luku.
Tuwei uku si sisyeme ŋaimune ŋaiye si ŋende me ti pe, ti hiꞌgwarnge supule pe, ti wate tumbuhuroroꞌe wal ŋihip Jisas pe, ti waname mise gwande ŋaimune ŋaiye si ŋende me ti.
Jisas ŋaname na, “Amai ŋam, ŋoihmbwaip nin ŋaiye teŋeime ŋam pe, kin si ŋende miꞌme wahriꞌ epwa nin. Nin el topoꞌe ŋoihmbwaip ŋumwaiye. Wahriꞌ epwa nin si miꞌe.”
Ŋupe ŋaiye Jisas ŋanange taꞌe luku pe, mitiŋ syeꞌ yenge wusyep yase yukoh Jairus yat. Tinge yaname Jairus na, “Lahtuwei nin si wule. Prepwan ŋaiye na aŋaꞌe wah nihe elme jetmam.”
Jisas ŋasande wusyep ŋaiye tinge yanange pe, kin ŋaname Jairus na, “Na hiꞌgirnge, na pakai. Ŋoihmbwaip nin ka teŋeime Got bongol.”
Taꞌe luku pe, kin yukur ŋasande ŋaiye lenge mitiŋ lalme ka yotop kin yil. O Pita, Jems pe tatai kin Jon, tinge ŋilyehme yal topoꞌe kin.
Tinge ya jere yukoh Jairus pe, Jisas ŋetekeꞌe ŋaiye tinge yale yat, topoꞌe tinge hruhru yilil.
Kin nato yukoh pe, kin ŋana lenge na, “Detale ti yip yende taꞌe liki? Yip hruhru yilil me ŋaimune? Talah iki yukur wule. Ti wate posoh eꞌe.”
Tinge yesenetme wusyep kin. Kom kin ginyenme lenge mitiŋ lalme yate tas wicherꞌ, kut kin nambaꞌe yai mam talah topoꞌe jetalah kin hun pe, tinge yal yoto luh ŋaiye talah wate.
Kin narpe syep ti pe, kin nenge wusyep ŋimeser tititinge ŋanange na, “Talita kum!” Wusyep tehei taꞌe leꞌe, ‘Lahtuwei malaih, ŋam mana nin, ni tuhur!’
Nilyehe sai ti tahar gwan hlaꞌ pe, ti wale wat. Lahtuwei uku wahtaip ti 12. Tinge yetekeꞌe luku pe, tinge ŋoiheryembe wula wula.
Kom Jisas ŋana lenge wusyep erŋeme bongol nange yukur ka si yi yini lenge mitiŋ syeꞌ, na pakai. Miꞌe pe, kin ŋana lenge na, “Yaŋaꞌe ŋai syeꞌ ta wono!”
